name: Former Nieuw Dakota
description: Nieuw Dakota was an independent exhibition space for contemporary art on the NDSM wharf. Founded in 2009, it presented experimental exhibitions and performances for fifteen years. Its owner says the venue closed to the public in January 2025 while exploring a restart; this destination marks the former venue’s exterior.

facts.text: The organization says Nieuw Dakota is currently not accessible to the public and closed its public doors from January 2025.
Founded in 2009, Nieuw Dakota offered experimental exhibitions, performances, tours and educational activities on the NDSM wharf.
